title: Eyes from Many Roads
description:
Reaching the End should feel like the result of several adventures, not a single uninteresting shopping list. The paths to an Eye are meant to differ.

This is an introductory reading entry ONLY. It does not claim the dimension was entered, a boss was defeated, a relic was equipped, or any reward has been earned. Runtime-verified item/structure objectives will be authored later.

Field note: Collect eligible eyes through different optional journeys. Do not assume every named eye is mandatory.
